name: project-baseline
description: Testable readiness standard. The v1 rules (build/test/context/claims) were distilled from the author's own repo reviews, plus v2 additions pressure-tested against the prior-art field (OpenSSF Scorecard, SLSA, 12-factor, Google SRE, Diataxis, repolinter, Backstage/Cortex/OpsLevel, and many more). Each rule maps to a lesson or a cited source; blockers fail CI, everything else warns. Rules with a 'pack' only run when that pack is active (see packs); everything else is always on. The legacy 'profile' field mirrors the pack until the engine reads packs directly.

profiles.core: Always on. Universal, high-confidence, machine-checkable rules.
profiles.service: Auto-on when project_type=service (or listed in config.profiles). Operability/observability rules that only make sense for a running service.
profiles.advanced: Opt-in via config.profiles. Expert/niche rules (SBOM, code-scanning, mutation testing, symbol-integrity) that would be noise on most repos.

packs.claims: Opt-in via makes_external_claims:true (or profiles/packs/--profile claims). The claims register and per-claim record discipline.
packs.decisions: Opt-in via a non-empty decision_globs (or profiles/packs/--profile decisions). Decision-record status, edges, amendments and numbering.
packs.descriptor: Opt-in via profiles/packs/--profile descriptor. The baseline.repo.json descriptor: present, schema-valid, and judgment-carrying when it changes.
packs.service: Opt-in via project_type=service (or profiles/packs/--profile service). Operability/observability rules that only make sense for a running service.
packs.advanced: Opt-in via profiles/packs/--profile advanced. Expert/niche rules (SBOM, code-scanning, mutation testing, symbol-integrity) that would be noise on most repos.
